device.category: duophonic analogue synthesizer, 37 keys, with sequencer, arpeggiator and effects
device.based_on: ARP Odyssey (1972-81), including its three filter revisions (4023, 4035, 4075).

sources.title: Behringer ODYSSEY Quick Start Guide
sources.note: Multilingual; English controls (68 callouts), getting started, sequencer, parameter set, SysEx, MIDI, effects and specifications used.

architecture.signal_path_note: analogue voice; digital Klark Teknik effects
architecture.polyphony_mode: duophonic: VCO-1 plays the lowest held note, VCO-2 the highest
architecture.patch_memory_note: No sound memory; 64 sequencer patterns (8 banks of 8), up to 32 steps each.
architecture.summary: Two VCOs (sawtooth and pulse) with sync, a ring modulator, white or pink noise, and a sample and hold fed by its own two-channel mixer. A low-pass filter switchable between the ARP 4023 (2-pole), 4035 and 4075 (4-pole), a high-pass filter and drive, an ADSR and an AR envelope, and a VCA. Modulation is set by paired faders and source switches throughout, ARP style. Adds proportional pitch pads, a 32-step sequencer with 64 patterns, an eight-mode arpeggiator, 32 Klark Teknik effects, MIDI, USB and CV/gate/trigger.

modules.name: Keyboard
modules.description: 37 semi-weighted keys with velocity; duophonic: low note to VCO-1, high note to VCO-2. Transpose ±2 octaves, portamento.

modules.name: Proportional pitch control
modules.description: Three pressure-sensitive pads: pitch down, pitch up, and LFO modulation; harder pressure, more effect.

modules.name: Sequencer and arpeggiator
modules.description: 32-step sequencer (64 patterns in 8 banks) with keyboard and step modes, ratchet, accent, swing and gate length; eight-mode arpeggiator.

modules.name: MIDI
modules.description: MIDI and USB MIDI notes, pitch bend and clock.

modules.name: LFO
modules.description: Sine and square outputs; also clocks the S/H and the LFO repeat.

modules.name: VCO-1
modules.description: Sawtooth and pulse; coarse and fine frequency; can drop to a low, keyboard-independent frequency (LF KYBD OFF).

modules.name: VCO-2
modules.description: Sawtooth and pulse; coarse and fine frequency; hard sync to VCO-1.

modules.name: Noise generator
modules.description: White or pink noise.

modules.name: Ring modulator
modules.description: Ring modulation of the two VCOs; turn sync off when using it.

modules.name: Sample and hold
modules.description: Two-channel S/H mixer (VCO-1 saw or pulse; noise or VCO-2 pulse) sampled on LFO or keyboard triggers, with output lag. The S/H mixer output is also a modulation source in its own right.

modules.name: Audio mixer
modules.description: Three faders: noise or ring mod, VCO-1 saw or pulse, VCO-2 saw or pulse.

modules.name: VCF
modules.description: Resonant low-pass in three modes: 2-pole 4023 (12 dB/oct), 4-pole 4035 and 4-pole 4075 (24 dB/oct).

modules.name: HPF
modules.description: High-pass filter after the VCF.

modules.name: Drive
modules.description: Switchable drive stage.

modules.name: ADSR
modules.description: Attack 5 ms-5 s, decay 10 ms-10 s, sustain 0-100%, release 15 ms-10 s.

modules.name: AR
modules.description: Attack 5 ms-5 s, release 10 ms-10 s; like the ADSR with decay at zero and sustain at maximum.

modules.name: Keyboard/LFO repeat
modules.description: Lets either envelope be gated by the keyboard or retriggered at the LFO rate, on key press or continuously.

modules.name: VCA
modules.description: Amplitude from the ADSR or AR envelope, plus a GAIN fader for a level not triggered by the keyboard.

modules.name: Klark Teknik effects
modules.description: 32 programs (reverbs, delays, echo, chorus, flanger, phaser, pan/tremolo, detune and more), three parameters each, tap tempo, FX SEND level.

modules.name: Output
modules.description: Main outputs (high and low level) and headphones.

modules.name: Pedal input
modules.description: Optional volume pedal as a modulation source for VCO-2 FM and the VCF.

behaviours.name: Duophonic voicing
behaviours.rule: With one key held both VCOs play it. With two or more, VCO-1 takes the lowest note and VCO-2 the highest. LF KYBD OFF frees VCO-1 from the keyboard as a low-frequency source.

behaviours.name: Fader-and-switch modulation
behaviours.rule: Each modulation fader sets a depth and its switch picks the source, as on the ARP Odyssey: VCO FM from the LFO, S/H, ADSR, S/H mixer or pedal; PWM from the LFO or ADSR; VCF from keyboard CV, S/H mixer, pedal, S/H, LFO, ADSR or AR; VCA from the ADSR or AR. VCF and VCA can use different envelopes.

behaviours.name: Sample and hold
behaviours.rule: Two mixer channels (VCO-1 saw or pulse; noise or VCO-2 pulse) are summed and sampled on each LFO cycle or key. The unsampled S/H mixer output is a separate modulation source. OUTPUT LAG slews the steps.

behaviours.name: Repeat
behaviours.rule: Either envelope can be gated by the keyboard or retriggered at the LFO rate. KYBD REPEAT retriggers only while a key is held; AUTO REPEAT runs continuously.

behaviours.name: Filter modes
behaviours.rule: The three ARP Odyssey filter revisions: 4023 (2-pole, 12 dB/oct, Mk I), 4035 (4-pole, 24 dB/oct, Mk II) and 4075 (4-pole, 24 dB/oct, Mk III).

behaviours.name: Arpeggiator
behaviours.rule: ARP once plays while keys are held; twice, or with HOLD, latches. Eight orders: up, down, down and up, random, and up or down with one octave added above or below, changed with <KYBD/STEP>.

behaviours.name: Sequencer
behaviours.rule: Up to 32 steps over four pages; 64 patterns in 8 banks. Keyboard mode records from the keys (REC); step mode edits steps freely (SHIFT + step). Steps take notes, rests, accents, gate length, portamento and ratchets (1-4). Live: SHIFT + PORTAMENTO ratchets all steps, SHIFT + TEMPO adds swing, SHIFT + HOLD/REST mutes, SHIFT + RESET/ACCENT accents all, TRANSPOSE shifts octave. Save with SHIFT + PLAY/STOP (two seconds), choose pattern and bank, then SHIFT + REC.

behaviours.name: Accent
behaviours.rule: On the keyboard, velocity above a threshold (set or disabled in SynthTool) triggers accent; holding RESET/ACCENT forces it, a double press latches it.

behaviours.name: No sound check
behaviours.rule: If the keyboard is silent, SHIFT + <KYBD returns to keyboard mode (step mode ignores the keys), and REC should be off.

behaviours.name: Warm-up
behaviours.rule: Allow 15 minutes or more, longer from cold.

midi.channel_note: Separate input and output channels, 1-16; set on the panel, by SysEx or in SynthTool.

source_inconsistencies: The power adaptor is 9 V DC 1700 mA in one specifications table and 9 V DC 1300 mA in another.
The specifications call the pulse waveforms 'square wave' in the mixer and S/H lists; the controls call them pulse.
VCO-1's first FM switch is labelled 'LFO sine or square' in the controls and 'LFO sinewave, LFO square wave' in the specifications; VCO-2's equivalent adds S/H mixer and pedal.

modelling_gaps.detail: A quick start guide; signal order after the filter and the CV jack list are inferred.
32 programs are recorded by count; their algorithms are not modelled.
The ARP Odyssey itself is not modelled; an original manual would allow a TB-303/TD-3 style pair.
